settings.text: Sustainability is a core aspect of the Access Booth's design. It incorporates recycled materials, with each booth containing approximately ≥396.83 lb of recycled materials per 12m²/0.66m³. The booth also boasts a remarkably low carbon footprint of ≤0.071kg CO2e and minimal energy consumption of ≤0.4MJ, aligning with our commitment to eco-conscious design.
